_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2014 10-K); 'Some of these services charge a nominal or no fee for access to their content, which could adversely affect demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2014 10-K); 'Some of these services charge a nominal or no fee for access to their content, which could adversely affect demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.17x; +27% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.06; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.4%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +31.5%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2015-03-27) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.17x (28.5% downside to Bear $40 / +166.4% upside to Bull $149) | Adj composite 1.79 vs market 1.73: gap +0.06 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +27% above the EPP floor $44 (15x FY15E $2.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: +8.5% total (+4.2%/yr) | At 19.1x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $74 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -0.9% in Q4 2014, forward revenues +4.8% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2014 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
